# Gulati & Sons

> A modern luxury lifestyle house of perfumes, deodorants, and horological demonstration timepieces. Established in taste, not in years.

## Official Organization Details
- **Website:** https://gulatiandsons.com
- **Founder:** Varun Gulati
- **Concierge Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 83750 44808
- **Concierge Email:** gulatiandsons.info@gmail.com
- **Territory Coverage:** Pan-India insured delivery across all 28 states and 8 union territories.

## Core Product Collections
- **Perfumes (Extrait & Eau de Parfum):** Santal Imperial (INR 18,500), Oud Royale (INR 24,000), Rose de May (INR 16,500), Vetiver Racine (INR 14,000), Amber Nobilis (INR 19,500).
- **Luxury Deodorants (Natural All-Day Formulation):** Santal & Cardamom Deodorant Spray (INR 3,200), Bergamot & Cedar Dry Stick (INR 2,800).
- **Timepieces (Horological Demonstration Editions):** Oyster Perpetual Demonstration Chronometer (INR 32,000), Royal Marine Demonstration (INR 28,500).

## Customer & Logistics Policies
- **Shipping:** Complimentary insured white-glove dispatch on orders exceeding INR 5,000. Flat INR 250 courier fee on smaller orders.
- **Dispatch Timeline:** Dispatched from atelier hubs within 24 to 48 hours; delivery across tier-1 Indian metros in 2-4 business days, and remaining regions in 3-6 business days.
- **Payment Methods:** UPI, Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay, Amex), Net Banking, and White-Glove Handover (COD).
- **Order Tracking:** Real-time tracking at https://gulatiandsons.com/track-order using Order ID and customer email/phone.
- **Returns & Exchanges:** Unopened, tamper-sealed consignments eligible for return within 7 days of verified delivery.
